title: 15 Online Jobs for Teachers in India 2026: Pay and Platforms
summary: Tutoring platforms, course creation, exam work, reported pay, how to apply, and what government teachers must check.
body_markdown:
The best online jobs for teachers in India are live tutoring, English teaching, maths tutoring, exam coaching, course creation and academic content work. You need a laptop or tablet, stable internet and a subject you teach well. Pay varies a lot, from about ₹300 to ₹800 an hour on tutor marketplaces to more for qualified tutors on larger platforms (LearnPick and Earn From Home India, retrieved 2026-11-06). Government teachers should check service rules first.


Below are 15 online teaching jobs with the skills each needs and how to apply. Pay figures come from job guides and aren't confirmed by the platforms, so check each platform's own tutor page. Women returning to teaching can also read[work from home jobs for women](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-jobs-for-women/) .


# Job Starting cost Skills needed Best for


1 Live Online Tutor on a Platform None Subject expertise, demo class School and exam teachers


2 Maths Tutor None Strong maths, patience with children Maths teachers


3 English Teacher on Preply None Good spoken English Confident English speakers


4 Homework Help Expert None Subject expertise Science, maths and commerce teachers


5 Independent Online Tutor None Teaching, a little marketing Experienced teachers


6 Online Course Creator Low Subject expertise, simple video Teachers with a clear niche


7 Competitive Exam Coach Low Exam expertise Coaches with proven results


8 Curriculum and Content Developer None Subject and writing skills Teachers who write well


9 Online Paper Setter and Evaluator None Subject expertise, accuracy Experienced teachers


10 Teaching Assistant or Doubt Solver None Subject knowledge, patience New teachers


11 YouTube Educator Low Clear teaching, consistency Teachers who enjoy the camera


12 Academic Editor or Proofreader None Strong grammar, subject knowledge Language and research teachers


13 Spoken Language Teacher None Fluency, teaching Language teachers


14 Educational Counsellor None Knowledge of courses and careers Experienced teachers


15 Selling Financial Products With GroMo None Basic phone use; free training in the app Anyone 18 or older


Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates: None, Very low, Low, Medium and High. Actual costs depend on your city and setup.


How this list is ranked: roles that use your teaching skills directly come first, followed by content and evaluation work. GroMo is last because it isn't a teaching job; it's an extra income option for teachers who want one.


## 1. Live Online Tutor on a Platform: Vedantu, Unacademy and others


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Subject expertise, demo class | **Best for:** School and exam teachers


Live tutoring platforms hire teachers for structured online classes. One guide reports ₹500 to ₹1,500 an hour for qualified tutors on Vedantu and Unacademy (Earn From Home India, retrieved 2026-11-06), but this isn't confirmed by the platforms, so check their own pages.


How to start:


1. Prepare your subject and a demo lesson.
2. Apply on the platform's careers page.
3. Check pay, hours and contract terms.


## 2. Maths Tutor: Cuemath and similar platforms


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Strong maths, patience with children | **Best for:** Maths teachers


Maths-focused platforms such as Cuemath hire tutors for younger children, usually after a subject test and a demo class. Pay terms vary, and some platforms expect fixed slots, so read the contract carefully.


How to start:


1. Check the platform's tutor requirements.
2. Prepare for its test and demo.
3. Confirm your slots and pay terms.


## 3. English Teacher on Preply: Teach learners worldwide


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Good spoken English | **Best for:** Confident English speakers


Preply lets you teach English to learners worldwide, and one guide says it pays through Payoneer, which means dollar-linked income for Indian tutors (retrieved 2026-11-06). Check platform commissions and conversion fees to understand what you'd actually receive.


How to start:


1. Create your profile and a short intro video.
2. Set a fair starting rate.
3. Ask early students for reviews.


## 4. Homework Help Expert: Answer student questions


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Subject expertise | **Best for:** Science, maths and commerce teachers


Homework help sites such as Chegg pay experts for answering student questions, per one source (retrieved 2026-11-06). It's flexible since you work without live classes, but pay depends on question volume, so don't count on it alone.


How to start:


1. Check the site's subject requirements.
2. Pass the subject test.
3. Start with the questions you know best.


## 5. Independent Online Tutor: Set your own fees


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Teaching, a little marketing | **Best for:** Experienced teachers


Teaching independently lets you set your own fees and keep more of what you earn. Marketplaces such as LearnPick report ₹300 to ₹800 an hour on average (LearnPick, retrieved 2026-11-06), and parents' referrals will become your best source of students over time. See more ways to add income in our list of[side income sources](https://gromo.in/blog/side-income-sources/) .


How to start:


1. Start with students from your own contacts.
2. Use Google Meet or Zoom.
3. Collect fees through a clear monthly plan.


## 6. Online Course Creator: Teach once, sell many times


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** Subject expertise, simple video | **Best for:** Teachers with a clear niche


Course creators record lessons once and sell them many times. Marketing is the hard part, so start with a small course on one specific problem, and test it with your own students before you put it on a large platform.


How to start:


1. Pick one specific problem to teach.
2. Record a short pilot course.
3. Test it with your own students first.


## 7. Competitive Exam Coach: SSC, banking, NEET and more


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** Exam expertise | **Best for:** Coaches with proven results


Exam coaches teach in online batches for competitive exams. Your results are your marketing, so collect genuine feedback, and never promise a rank or selection, because no teacher can guarantee that.


How to start:


1. Pick one exam you know deeply.
2. Run a free demo session.
3. Start a small paid batch.


## 8. Curriculum and Content Developer: Write lessons and books


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Subject and writing skills | **Best for:** Teachers who write well


Edtech firms and publishers hire teachers to write lessons, worksheets and question banks. This work suits teachers who prefer writing over live classes, and it can often be done as freelance projects on a flexible schedule. See more ways to freelance in[freelance jobs online](https://gromo.in/blog/freelance-jobs-online/) .


How to start:


1. Create sample worksheets.
2. Apply to edtech firms and publishers.
3. Agree the rate per project.


## 9. Online Paper Setter and Evaluator: Check and set exam papers


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Subject expertise, accuracy | **Best for:** Experienced teachers


Online evaluators check answer sheets and set question papers for coaching institutes and edtech firms. Work is often seasonal and paid per paper, so it fits well as extra income around school hours.


How to start:


1. Contact coaching institutes and edtech firms.
2. Share your subject and experience.
3. Confirm the rate per paper.


## 10. Teaching Assistant or Doubt Solver: Support live classes


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Subject knowledge, patience | **Best for:** New teachers


Teaching assistants solve doubts and support live classes for edtech companies and coaching institutes. It's a good entry point for newer teachers, who can learn how online classes run before taking on classes of their own. Recent graduates can also see[work from home jobs for freshers](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-jobs-for-freshers/) .


How to start:


1. Apply to edtech companies.
2. Prepare for a subject test.
3. Ask about hours and pay per session.


## 11. YouTube Educator: Free lessons, long-term income


**Starting cost:** Low | **Skills:** Clear teaching, consistency | **Best for:** Teachers who enjoy the camera


YouTube educators earn from ads, courses and sponsors after building an audience, which usually takes many months. Choose one subject and class level, keep videos simple, and treat it as a long-term project rather than quick income.


How to start:


1. Choose a narrow subject and class.
2. Post weekly for several months.
3. Add a paid course once you have viewers.


## 12. Academic Editor or Proofreader: Check research and assignments


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Strong grammar, subject knowledge | **Best for:** Language and research teachers


Academic editors proofread theses, papers and reports for students and researchers. Edit for language and clarity only, because writing someone's assignment for them can break academic rules, and you shouldn't take on that kind of work.


How to start:


1. Create a clear service description.
2. Edit sample pages.
3. Offer language editing only.


## 13. Spoken Language Teacher: Hindi, regional and foreign languages


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Fluency, teaching | **Best for:** Language teachers


Spoken language teachers help learners with Hindi, regional or foreign languages for work, travel or exams. Online classes let you reach learners across cities and overseas, and small group batches keep your fee affordable for students.


How to start:


1. Choose your language and learner level.
2. Prepare a simple course outline.
3. Offer a trial class.


## 14. Educational Counsellor: Guide students and parents


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Knowledge of courses and careers | **Best for:** Experienced teachers


Educational counsellors advise students on courses, colleges and careers. Teachers have a natural advantage here since parents already trust them. Be open if a college or company pays you for referrals, because honesty is what your reputation rests on. Compare other flexible options in our[side business ideas](https://gromo.in/blog/side-business-ideas/) .


How to start:


1. Learn about admissions in your area.
2. Offer a paid session to one family.
3. Disclose any referral payments.


## 15. Selling Financial Products With GroMo: Bank-paid commissions, no stock


**Starting cost:** None | **Skills:** Basic phone use; free training in the app | **Best for:** Anyone 18 or older


Selling financial products with GroMo tops this list because it costs nothing to start and needs only a smartphone. GroMo is a free app where you help people apply for credit cards, savings accounts, loans and demat accounts from partner banks, and you earn a commission when the application is approved. On GroMo, credit cards pay up to ₹2,000, savings accounts up to ₹1,000, demat accounts up to ₹450, and personal loans up to 4.5% of the loan amount (GroMo catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-06). It isn't a teaching job, but teachers are often trusted for money advice, and helping a parent open a savings account fits around school hours. Check your school contract first; government teachers need to follow service rules. The pay is commission only, with no fixed salary, and only approved applications earn; you must be 18 or older.


How to start:


1. Download the GroMo app and register free with your phone number.
2. Finish the one-time verification and the free in-app training.
3. Share a product link with someone who genuinely needs it, then track the application in the app.

## How much do online teachers earn in India?


Online teachers in India often earn about ₹300 to ₹800 an hour on tutor marketplaces, and one guide reports ₹500 to ₹1,500 an hour for qualified tutors on large platforms (LearnPick and Earn From Home India, retrieved 2026-11-06). These figures come from job guides, not the platforms themselves. Pay depends on subject, experience and hours, so confirm it on each platform's tutor page.


## Can government teachers do online jobs?


Government teachers generally need to check their service rules before taking other paid work, because many rules restrict private tuition or outside employment. Rules vary by state and department, so ask your department in writing before you start. Private school teachers should also check their contracts for any limits on outside teaching.


## What do you need to start teaching online?


You need a laptop or tablet, stable internet, a quiet room, a good microphone and a simple way to show your writing, such as a digital pen or small whiteboard. A short demo lesson helps with both platforms and parents. Your teaching degree may help, but many platforms care more about subject tests and demo classes.


## How do you avoid online teaching job scams?


Avoid any online teaching job that asks you to pay a registration fee or buy a training course to get students. Fake listings often copy known brand names, so apply through the company's official site. One 2026 source also says BYJU'S is no longer an active option for most tutors (FindMyGuru, retrieved 2026-11-06), so check before applying to any listing.


**GroMo** is a free app where partners help customers apply for credit cards, loans, savings accounts and demat accounts from partner banks, and earn a commission on approval.


## FAQ: Online Jobs for Teachers


### What is the best online job for teachers?


Live tutoring on a platform or teaching your own online batches is usually the best fit, since it uses your existing skills. Content writing and evaluation work suit those who don't want live classes.


### Can teachers work from home in India?


Yes. Teachers can tutor, write curriculum content, evaluate papers and create courses from home with a laptop and steady internet.


### Which platform pays teachers the most?


There's no reliable answer, because pay depends on subject and experience. Reported figures vary, so compare each platform's tutor page and contract.


### Do I need a B.Ed for online teaching jobs?


Not always. Many platforms care more about subject knowledge, tests and demo classes, though some roles ask for a teaching qualification.


### Can government teachers teach online?


Check your service rules first. Many rules restrict private tuition or outside paid work, and they vary by state and department.


### Can teachers earn with GroMo?


Yes, if you're 18 or older and your employer's rules allow it. It's commission-only, with no fixed income, and you earn when applications are approved.


GroMo (Vitrak Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a distribution platform. GroMo isn't a bank, NBFC, insurer or investment adviser. All products are offered by their respective RBI, IRDAI or SEBI-regulated providers.


Partner earnings depend on effort, product mix and customer eligibility. Any figures shown are illustrative. They aren't typical and aren't promised.


Sources: Top-ranking guides checked: Careers360, Earn From Home India, FindMyGuru, LearnPick and Weekday, retrieved 2026-11-06. GroMo product catalogue, commission rates by product, retrieved 2026-11-06.


## Disclaimer


GroMo doesn't promise any level of income. Commissions are set by partner banks, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app. Starting-cost labels are our own rough estimates, and any pay figures from other sites or job listings are what those sources state, not a guarantee. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above. Everything above is general information, not financial, legal or career advice.
